caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall, octagonal metal object resembling a public hydrant or water pump, placed centrally on an empty beige background. The object is rendered in tones of greenish-gray with areas of brown and blue, suggesting aged or weathered metal, and horizontal dark bands are present near the top and bottom edges. It has a flat, faceted lid with two small protruding elements and a chain-attached cap hanging from the upper midsection, which sits in front of a raised “V” shaped mark. The overall composition is simple, with no additional objects or background details except for a small artist’s signature, "MINA LOWRY.", in the lower right corner.
title: Fire Hydrant
